description: Source code implementing deconvolution operations using oneDNN (DNNL) with SYCL interop, including forward and backward passes, for XPU hardware.

methods.name: deconv_compatible_dilation
methods.description: Adjusts dilation array for oneDNN compatibility by subtracting 1 from each element.

methods.name: compatible_groups_deconv_strides
methods.description: Computes strides for grouped deconvolution based on weight tensor strides and group size.

methods.name: deconv_dst_size
methods.description: Calculates output size for deconvolution given input size, weight size, padding, stride, dilation, dst padding, and groups.

methods.name: deconv_src_fmt
methods.description: Determines the memory format tag for source tensor based on number of dimensions and channels last setting.

methods.name: deconv_weight_fmt
methods.description: Determines the memory strides for weight tensor based on grouping and channels last setting.

methods.name: deconv_compatible_weight_dims
methods.description: Returns weight tensor dimensions compatible with oneDNN based on input parameters.

methods.name: deconv_get_plain_md
methods.description: Creates memory descriptors for source, weight, and destination tensors for deconvolution.

methods.name: deconvolution
methods.description: Performs forward deconvolution using oneDNN with SYCL interop, returning an event.

methods.name: deconvolution_backward_data
methods.description: Performs backward data pass of deconvolution using oneDNN with SYCL interop.

methods.name: deconvolution_backward_weights
methods.description: Performs backward weights update for deconvolution using oneDNN with SYCL interop.
